definitions.mitt_reading_pixels: assistant mitt point minus the person's on the same decision frame, source pixels
definitions.mitt_reading_feet_same_plate: both mitt points mapped through the person's plate front edge and the game's hop-2 matrix; isolates the mitt reading
definitions.output_vs_person_feet: published plate_feet (JSONL) minus the person's mitt mapped through the person's plate front edge and the game's hop-2 matrix; shares the matrix, so it is not a physical-accuracy measurement
definitions.camera_check_catch_vs_statcast: the only physical check: assistant-read ball in the mitt through hops 1-2 vs the Statcast trajectory (intent.calibrate); no person
definitions.assistant abstention_rate: unavailable lines / lines in the game's output
definitions.person_abstention_rate: frames the person marked hidden / not in setup / not centre field, over the frames the person decided; abstentions are not counted as marked
definitions.x, z: x = statcast_plate_x catcher view (feet), z = height (feet); dx/dy in pixels are image right/down
definitions.percentiles: nearest-rank median and 90th percentile everywhere; signed blocks add the mean and the standard error of the mean

m3_requirement.rule: at least 50 person-marked pitches over at least 2 evaluation games that each have at least one person-marked pitch (abstentions do not count)

fallback.rule: only when both planned evaluation games are labeled and have fewer than 50 person-marked pitches together: add 849849, then 849851 if still short (intent_eval_plan_v0.json)

coverage.selection: pitches the condensed game shows (mostly plate-appearance-ending)
pitches the condensed game shows (mostly plate-appearance-ending)
pitches the condensed game shows (mostly plate-appearance-ending)

camera_check_catch_vs_statcast.signed_means_note: omitted: fewer than min_pitches catches; raw values in the calibration file

evaluation_pooled.scope: evaluation games with imported labels only; development games never pooled

assistant.abstention_rate_denominator: output lines summed over the pooled games

evaluation_pooled.person_abstention_rate_denominator: frames the person decided, summed over the pooled games

mitt_reading_pixels.denominator: frames where both the assistant and the person marked a mitt

mitt_reading_feet_same_plate.denominator: both marked a mitt and the person marked the plate front edge

output_vs_person_feet.denominator: both marked a mitt, the person marked the plate front edge, and the published line reached plate_feet

example_cases.rule: among frames where both marked a mitt: representative = output feet error closest to the median, best = smallest, worst = largest (mitt pixel distance when no frame reached plate_feet); ties by pitch_id; chosen by code, never by hand

limits: Person-vs-assistant numbers use the same hop-2 matrix on both sides; they measure the reading, not the physical accuracy of plate_feet.
The person labels the assistant's decision frame; whether that is the right setup frame is not evaluated.
Condensed games show mostly plate-appearance-ending pitches; the evaluated pitches are not a random sample of the games.
Catchers in these games rest the glove on the dirt until release; plate_feet.z is the resting glove height, not a target height.
823407: the pitching rubber is hidden on the low FOX camera, so pan is unmeasured (0 by rule) and the camera check has 2 catches (unmeasured).
One labeler, one pass; no second person, so person-to-person variation is unmeasured.
The labeling instruction that a resting glove counts as the setup was written after the assistant outputs were seen (before any label arrived); see the deviations in docs/INTENT_V0_M3_EVAL.md.
no_threshold: no pass/fail threshold was set in advance; the numbers are reported with n
